data.narrative:
Firestorm Labs is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $60M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 4 private companies in the same sector and stage, with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), alongside 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using $82M as a total-raised proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $164M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 private comparables yields a median valuation of $700M, reflecting substantial variation in the Defense & Security frontier-tech landscape—the peer set spans from $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $139M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $432M. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around growth trajectory and defensibility within an evolving sector. The peer-median method pulls the range significantly higher than stage-progression alone, suggesting that comparable Defense & Security Series A businesses command multiples well above typical venture step-ups. Key uncertainties include differentiation relative to better-capitalized peers like Stark Defence and Castelion, and the extent to which current stage-progression multiples remain valid given the outlier valuations in the comp set.
